ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(CloseDate) ), CloseDate < DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()) - 1, 1), CloseDate >= DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()) - 2, 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date of an opportunity is not within a month prior to the current month
